response.sql: WITH account_trans AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(t.amount) as account_total, COUNT(t.trans_id) as trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_totals AS (SELECT region, SUM(account_total) as region_total FROM account_trans GROUP BY region) SELECT at.account_id, at.region, at.account_total, at.trans_count, CASE WHEN rt.region_total > 0 THEN CAST(at.account_total AS REAL) / rt.region_total * 100 ELSE NULL END as share FROM account_trans at JOIN region_totals rt ON at.region = rt.region ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10
